name: operator==, operator<=>(std::coroutine_handle)

declarations.code:
constexpr bool

operator==(std::coroutine_handle<> x, std::coroutine_handle<> y) noexcept;

constexpr std::strong_ordering

operator<=>(std::coroutine_handle<> x, std::coroutine_handle<> y) noexcept;

intro:
Compares two std::coroutine_handle<> values x and y according to their underlying addresses.

The <, <=, >, >=, and != operators are synthesized from operator<=> and operator== respectively.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
x, y

 -

 std::coroutine_handle<> values to compare

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: Although these operators are only overloaded for std::coroutine_handle<>, other specializations of std::coroutine_handle are also equality comparable and three-way comparable, because they are implicitly convertible to std::coroutine_handle<>.
